title: Multi-Site Feasibility Testing a Meditation App for Youth in the Legal System
official: Improving Psychological Wellbeing and Decreasing Psychological Distress Among Youth in the Legal System: Multi-Site Feasibility Trial of a Mindfulness Meditation App
summary: This multi-site feasibility clinical trial aims to assess the feasibility of implementing a 1-month app-based meditation program with youth in 4 heterogeneous juvenile legal systems across Oregon and New York. The primary question it is designed to answer is: Will youth adequately adhere to the 1-month meditation app across sites? Secondary feasibility outcomes pertain to recruitment, randomization, retention, and survey completion.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* 13-20 years old
* In probation or related programming (i.e., in legal programming but not detained) in Oregon or New York State
* Have access to an Apple/Android smartphone
* Understand and provide assent/consent
* Have legal guardian permission (if under 18 years old)
* English-speaking, due to norming of instruments

Exclusion Criteria:

\- There are no exclusion criteria.
